title: Determination 2024/061: Proposed notice to fix for a cable car building, two stairways and a toilet and shower building (clauses D1 and F4)
jurisdiction: New Zealand: Nelson City Council as territorial authority; MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004. Non-Alberta comparative record.
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992), clauses D1 (access routes) and F4 (safety from falling). No Acceptable Solution edition is named in the text read.

facts.text: The building work at a property in Moana, Nelson includes a cable car building, two sets of stairs, and a toilet and shower building.

The upper stairway leads up from the driveway to an elevated landing 1.53 m above the driveway. The landing is supported on two sides by retaining walls. The site layout diagram labels the upper and lower stairways and the dwelling levels.
The owner intends to construct a handrail to the upper stairway and a barrier to the elevated landing, and a handrail to the lower stairway.

The matter is the authority's proposed notice to fix and the stairways' compliance with D1 and F4. It includes whether handrails or a barrier are required, whether consent was needed for the work, and whether the elevated landing was exempt.
